capabilities: Styles headings, text, and code blocks to match VitePress
Renders VitePress containers, badges, and emoji shortcodes
Adds code block titles, groups, line numbers, and line annotations
Enhances external and relative links with favicons and line highlights
Provides settings for colors, typography, and parsing toggles
disambiguation: Not a VitePress site generator; it styles and renders VitePress-style Markdown inside Obsidian.
extras: Most VitePress syntax renders only in Reading mode; Live Preview supports table and typography styles only. External favicons are fetched via favicon.im.
motivation: To bring a great reading experience to VitePress-based documentation within Obsidian.
problem: VitePress documentation opened in Obsidian loses its containers, code annotations, and typography, so it reads differently from the published site.

relations.evidence: A VitePress-style theme plugin for Obsidian, bringing a great reading experience to VitePress-based documentation within Obsidian.

summary: Theme plugin that styles Obsidian notes like VitePress documentation and renders VitePress containers, code blocks, badges, and emoji.
